method: Native browser review page, no synthetic FPS. Same stage s12, camera, high quality, 1280x720, two heroes, no towers. Rigid NPCs are ashigaru/samurai/teppo. Initial NPC sync includes model preparation. 60fps display cap applies.
limits: Single Windows PC/browser observation. Equal capped FPS is not evidence of an FPS increase. Setup timing has cache/order variance and is not steady-state frame timing. Does not establish performance on phones or other hardware. All comparison captures use valid reconstructed canvases after the development review page was corrected.
